headline: Anthropic and OpenAI release cheaper, stronger models
summary: Anthropic and OpenAI both announced new AI models that are more powerful and cheaper, with outlets framing the releases as the frontier AI race entering a comparison-shopping phase.

claims.statement: Anthropic and OpenAI both announced new AI models that are more powerful and cheaper.

sources.quote: Anthropic and OpenAI announce more powerful (and cheaper) AI models
New Anthropic, OpenAI models make same promise: A little more for a lot less money

claims.statement: Ars Technica frames the releases as the frontier AI model race entering a "comparison shopping phase."

sources.quote: The frontier AI model race has entered its comparison shopping phase.

claims.statement: Engadget notes the releases come despite talk of slowing down AI development.

sources.quote: I thought we were supposed to be slowing down the frontier.
